policy: Only independently reviewed Bengali-script pronunciation is published as verified; generated drafts remain explicitly unverified and are not treated as corrections.
source: Verified records were reviewed against Arabic and Bengali pronunciation conventions; generated draft entries are retained only as unverified drafts and are not represented as fully manually verified.

audit.method: Only the verified range was independently reviewed. Remaining records have structural Arabic/verse alignment checks but no human pronunciation review and no tajwid certification.

draft.method: Arabic-character-aligned Bengali phonetic draft; automated structural/readback checked, not human-reviewed
